Gets a feed's details and its latest ite: 取得 Feed 的詳細資訊及其最新項目，依最新優先排序。
Gets the latest items from several feeds: 將多個 Feed 的最新項目作為單一清單取得，依最新優先排序。
Finds the RSS and Atom feeds a website p: 找出網站發布的 RSS 和 Atom Feed。
Link to the feed itself, not the site ho: Link to the feed itself, not the site homepage; Atom works too.
Maximum number of items to return, newes: 要回傳的項目數上限，依最新優先排序（1–100）。預設為 20。
Only return items published after this d: 只回傳在此日期和時間之後發布的項目。沒有發布日期的項目會被排除。
Only return items whose title, summary o: 只回傳標題、摘要或內容包含此文字的項目（不區分大小寫）。
One feed address per row; a feed that fa: One feed address per row; a feed that fails to load is skipped.
A page on the site, such as its homepage: 網站上的頁面，例如首頁或部落格文章。
Runs when a new item is published in an: Runs when a new item is published in an RSS feed.
Runs when a new item is published in any: Runs when a new item is published in any of the feeds you list.
